sahil: Opening short follow-up from the postmortem. Aim: clear owners, timelines, and minimal mitigations for cloud/model-registry/auth vendor outages. Ack + ETA please.

maria: Ack. I'll drive registry geo-replication (meta + blob checksums). Design doc Tue, PoC in 2 sprints.

alex: Taking auth fallback: cached JWKS + token-bridge signed by our KMS. PoC Fri EOD; integration tests next week.

anne: I'll lead vendor SLA updates and AE request. Draft to legal + vendor CS by Wed.

ops-oncall: I'll add cross-region synthetic checks + Grafana panel. Staging checks next Tue, prod after 48h stable.

julie: Ops asked for auto model fallback for public routes; I'll prepare packaging checklist and QA tests. Add metric: fallback_rate.

devops-bot: Tickets created: INF-3500 registry-repl (maria), INF-3501 auth-fallback (alex), INF-3502 vendor-slas (anne), INF-3503 synthetics (ops-oncall).

sahil: Summary: maria (INF-3500), alex (INF-3501), anne (INF-3502), ops-oncall (INF-3503), julie (fallback packaging). Weekly Jira updates, escalate blockers here prior to infra sync. DR drill Tuesday 09:00 PT 7. RSVP.

ops-oncall: RSVP noted; will run scenarios: auth provider down, region partition, registry read errors.

sahil: Thanks all. I'll post short daily status notes until PoCs or vendor commits are in place. Reopen thread if blockers arise.
